titulo: You built a ship. It flipped. 🚢 #engineering #shorts
descripcion:
From a tall, narrow hull that capsizes on the first wave to a loaded container ship that rights itself from 30 degrees: a wide hull, ballast that keeps the center of gravity low, and anti-roll tanks that calm the rolling.

What should we build next?

#engineering #ship #containership #navalarchitecture #howitworks #shorts

lineas.texto: You need to carry thousands of containers across the ocean.
So you build a tall, narrow hull and stack it full. Problem solved!
But the first big wave flips it right over.
So you make the hull wide. When it leans, the low side pushes up and shoves it back.
But stack the containers higher, and the weight up top drags it over again.
So you fill tanks at the very bottom with seawater. That ballast keeps the weight low.
But in a storm it still rolls back and forth, harder every time.
So you add a tank where water sloshes side to side, always a beat late. It fights the roll.
Now tip the loaded ship thirty degrees, and it swings back up on its own.
Congratulations! You just built a container ship. What should we build next?
